name: td-device
description: TradeDesk device-identity bridge. The web layer can only ever see navigator.userAgent (which iOS deliberately collapses to a generic "iPhone") plus screen.width/height, so a broken layout on a new phone can't be tied to the exact hardware. This exposes the real sysctl hardware identifier (e.g. iPhone17,2) and the OS device name (e.g. "Jack's iPhone"). Raw capability only: which identifier maps to which marketing name, if any, lives in JS.
